scope: Independent runtime implementation and actual main 7-library/6-ELF acceptance on main-source v2. This is not independent clean 2/2 or hardware acceptance.

resolved_findings.description: Post-final-K settled checks originally collapsed unexpected selector/reversal into ClockConfigurationTimeout.
resolved_findings.resolution: All pending and post-K selector checks now preserve LsiClockSwitchTimeout via final_source and exact LSI check.

resolved_findings.description: Pending K selector error originally preceded non-selector phase, LSI-readiness and Flash-pair checks.
resolved_findings.resolution: final_source checks non-selector phase and full live-source/Flash guard before returning the selector to the K loop.

resolved_findings.description: Extra immediate FLASH pre-access refusal returned without a repeated post-observation source guard.
resolved_findings.resolution: Initial capture and latency-write prechecks now repeat the read-only full guard before returning remembered access refusal.

resolved_findings.description: Erased raw factory value was rejected by admission but had first passed through the local typed mask.
resolved_findings.resolution: factory_trim is now Option<u16>; raw 0xffff never reaches typed set_trim, preserving exactly one volatile read and refusal precedence.

resolved_findings.description: First actual ARM build fails because own capability assertion uses raw IR block name SYSCTRL while generated metadata block name is Sysctrl; GPIO assertion also uses GPIO while actual generated metadata is Gpio.
resolved_findings.resolution: Two new build-validator literals now use generated Rust metadata block spelling Sysctrl/Gpio. All other authored files and modes match v1.

phase_review.finding: Original full snapshot; raw erased halfword withheld from typed trim; original software LSIEN/STABLE/factory equality; retained owner windows and exact inherited HSE matching before any source write.
Own FLASH reset checked before deliberate enable; actual gate error distinct; authoritative capture only with operational/reset checks and source guards; original pair must agree and be <=3.
FLASH WAIT original to3 only; independent FLASH/SYSCTRL matching-old or matching-target pair, mixed/other immediate refusal; authoritative non-WAIT image preserved.
Only HSIEN and HSI.STABLE independently progress to true; HSI parameters and complete other phase fields remain exact; HsiTimeout is exhaustion only.
One keyed CR0 RMW selects HSI and /8-or-larger guards; ACK accepts only whole prior or whole target tuple, then barrier and exact settled guard.
Retrim only: CLKCCS prior to false, no other pending field.
Retrim only: HSI to live LSI under fixed guards/WAIT3; third selector is immediate ClockConfigurationTimeout; valid-prior exhaustion is TemporaryClockSwitchTimeout.
Retrim only: HSIEN/STABLE independently to false; both required before parameter write.
Stopped HSI only: own typed TRIM and DIV independently prior to factory/requested; all RFU preserved; no readiness reversal.
HSIEN/STABLE independently to true with final parameters fixed; valid-prior exhaustion HsiTimeout.
LSI to ready factory HSI with fixed guards/WAIT3; third selector ClockConfigurationTimeout; valid-prior exhaustion ClockSwitchTimeout.
CLKCCS false to original only, acknowledged before continuing.
No-retrim branch changes only HSI.DIV; factory TRIM and enabled/ready HSI remain exact.
Fresh declared HSE only after original/current stopped/unready checks; complete GPIOF setup window bracketed by full source guards and gate-first result classification.
Only declared MODE/DRIVER/PDRIVER/WAITCYCLE/DIGFLT/DETCNT independently progress while HSE remains stopped; original HEXENPOL/RFU preserved.
Only HSEEN/STABLE independently progress to true, relevant HSE faults first; valid-prior exhaustion HseTimeout.
Live target excludes both legacy explicit LSIEN writes/polls and returns before native LSE start/verify; settled guard remains.
Dedicated tail verifies HSE pads with live policy and gate-first errors; full settled HSI/guard/WAIT3 state checked before final divider write.
CR0 explicitly retains HSI; only AHB/APB independently advance to final with no reversal; barrier and full settled check.
Final WAIT installed under factory HSI/final buses using strict pair; outward HCLK maxima include final LSI, configured HSI and full undivided 4.08MHz fallback.

Last clock/source/divider/FLASH write selects LSI; final_source checks all non-selector phase, live readiness and FLASH first; only HSI may wait, unexpected selector/exhaustion/reversal use LsiClockSwitchTimeout.
Only read-only final checks plus independently required borrowed GPIO gate restoration; final HSE matching followed by full final guard; no repair/reselect/rollback/native-LSE path.

reviewed_constraints: Exact C8T6/C8U6 capability only; generic L012 and L011 remain excluded.
Original software LSIEN, STABLE and own nine-bit factory match cannot be upgraded; raw0xffff is never masked and zero remains valid.
LSI non-STABLE mask0xffff7fff retains RFU9, WAIT and every other bit; HSI/HSE masks exclude only own STABLE and LSE18 is checked separately; all non-owned CR0/CR1/CR2/IER/MCO remain authority.
Relevant external faults sampled before and after collected images; immutable and phase mismatch precede LSI readiness; Flash pair precedes final-selector interpretation.

RTC actual PSC1+1 and raw HSIOSC ownership; ADC1/2 shared gate/EN; ungated LVD; shared VC1..4; OPA1/2; DAC; conditional separate I2C1/2 master/slave raw1/3 refusal inspected with independent restoration diagnostics.
No new UART3, timer or output-bank inspection; closed work gate does not prove absence; GPIOF whole-bank progression and both direct outputs are explicit public functional constraints.
Private Legacy/LseSysclk/LiveLsiSysclk HSE selector retains old mappings and uses one GPIOF live matcher window with detailed LSI gate errors; fresh setup alone intentionally leaves gate enabled.
No SYSCTRL.LSI write, explicit LSIEN operation or IWDT register/gate/reset/feed/pause operation reachable for live LSI; no source/divider/Flash write after final mux.
Shared RTC semantic identity remains raw HSIOSC3 at96MHz with94.08..97.92MHz strict bounds; no native LSI calendar alias.

Protected L010/shared RTC/bounds/peripheral/native LSE/ADC/PWM/time-driver/schema files remain baseline-identical. Old LSE finish differs only in two HSE enum arguments; its inspection/mapping helpers remain exact.

New38-line public init rustdoc is documentation only; removing it restores the full prior lib.rs bytes. Safe API retains the existing pre-Rust platform memory-ownership boundary and states additional requirements as functional handover constraints.
